requirements.title: CO_BROADCAST argument restrictions and intents
requirements.definition: A has corresponding shape, type, and type parameter values, is nonpolymorphic and not coindexed, and is INTENT(INOUT); SOURCE_IMAGE is an INTENT(IN) integer scalar naming an image in the current team with the same value in corresponding references; STAT and ERRMSG have the stated noncoindexed scalar forms and intents.

pending.A-corresponding-same-shape-type-paramete: Source-control only across corresponding references; no executable oracle is claimed for CO_BROADCAST argument correspondence in the single-image suite.
pending.A-not-polymorphic: Source-control uses a nonpolymorphic declared A. Polymorphic A is an unnumbered argument restriction without a diagnostic facet here.
pending.A-not-coindexed: Source-control uses a local noncoindexed A. A coindexed actual is an unnumbered argument restriction without a diagnostic facet here.
pending.A-intent-inout: Source-control records that A is INTENT(INOUT); no local singleton execution is used as an oracle for a CO_* intrinsic.
pending.SOURCE_IMAGE-current-team-scalar-same: Source-control uses scalar SOURCE_IMAGE=1 for a one-image current team form; multi-image disagreement or out-of-team values are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.STAT-noncoindexed-integer-range-at-least: Source-control uses a noncoindexed default integer scalar STAT variable; STAT assignment semantics are owned by 16.6 and are not observed here.
pending.ERRMSG-noncoindexed-default-character-sc: Source-control uses a noncoindexed default character scalar ERRMSG variable; ERRMSG text is never compared.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Argument restrictions are recorded as source-control obligations only; unnumbered argument restrictions carry no diagnostic facet. Runtime behavior of CO_* collective intrinsics is image-dependent and OUT OF SCOPE for this suite's single-image fixtures by user decision, so this packet deliberately claims no single-image local-coarray execution plan.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Argument 'shall' restrictions on intrinsic procedure references are program restrictions and are not promoted to diagnostic facets without a numbered constraint or other detection requirement. CO_* collective runtime effects, RESULT_IMAGE selection effects, cross-image computed values, stopped/failed-image status behavior, STAT values, and ERRMSG text are OUT OF SCOPE for this suite's single-image fixtures by user decision; no local singleton execution is used as an oracle.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies cited, not restated: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and registered 12-13 where existing source form, declarations, expressions, execution constructs, internal I/O, and exact character/numeric observations are used by future fixtures. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: earlier and later 16.9 intrinsic procedure semantics, 16.6 collective STAT/ERRMSG semantics, clause 15 procedure interface rules for CO_REDUCE operation arguments, clause 14 teams/images for collective execution, clause 17 IEEE behavior where real exceptional values could otherwise be reached, and clauses 3, 5, 18, and 19 for terminology, lexical representation, deleted features, and scope/lifetime controls.

requirements.title: CO_BROADCAST defines A from SOURCE_IMAGE when no error occurs
requirements.definition: If no error condition occurs, A becomes defined as if by intrinsic assignment on all images in the current team with the value from SOURCE_IMAGE, including allocatable potential subobject component allocation and dynamic type setting for polymorphic allocatable potential subobject components.
